content: Listings on employment platforms such as Indeed highlight ongoing recruitment for transport-related job roles in South Africa, including commercial drivers and operations managers, which strongly suggests sustained activity and operational execution in the logistics field, even if it fails to provide direct insights into specific bulk road transport contracts [23] . The integration of advanced digital tracking, fleet management software, and automated procurement systems represents a critical avenue for capital investment within the bulk road transport sector. These technological advancements not only streamline the bidding and contract management processes but also enhance the geographic outreach capabilities of logistics firms by providing real-time visibility into regional transport networks. Furthermore, given the opacity of finalized contract data, maintaining a proactive presence on procurement platforms and leveraging digital tools to monitor real-time tender opportunities will be crucial for securing future bulk road transport contracts. The continuous evolution of the South African logistics sector underscores the necessity for agile operational strategies and sustained capital investment in both physical fleet capabilities and digital infrastructure.
